svg.title: SOGA reference architecture, final
svg.desc: Two rationale boxes state why execution-time governance matters. Below, five protocols supply identity plus proof of delegation at the interface, each proving delegation a different way. AAuth, UCAN, and ZCAP are verified now. OAuth GNAP is targeted next week. AIIM supplies organizational context, but cross-domain portability remains an openly unresolved problem in the field, not just unverified internally. These converge into the built architecture below.
svg.text: solid = verified now · dashed = target or openly unresolved
Identity: AAuth (agent) + OIDF/OIDC (person) — relied upon, not built here
